citation.entry: 'Resolution-Basis Finding - The Real Phantom-Edge Driver (2026-09-14)' + 'UPDATE 2026-09-14 (supersedes parts of the above)'; decision recorded in CONTEXT.md 'Key Decisions' 2026-09-14

description: Architecture-level failure: the forecaster models Coinbase spot and labels outcomes on Coinbase closes, but Polymarket/Limitless binaries resolve on Chainlink (stale, low-pass; later pinpointed as Chainlink Data Streams RTDS, not even the collected mainnet feed).
